import json

# recompute properly: run transform without target
def transform(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if inp[i][j]==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            c=inp[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny][nx] and inp[ny][nx]==c:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
            ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
            ok = all(inp[y][x]==c for y in range(y0,y1+1) for x in range(x0,x1+1)
                     if y in(y0,y1) or x in(x0,x1)) and len(comp)==2*(y1-y0+1)+2*(x1-x0-1)
            if ok and y1>y0+1 and x1>x0+1:
                area=(y1-y0-1)*(x1-x0-1)
                fill=2 if area%2==0 else 7
                for y in range(y0+1,y1):
                    for x in range(x0+1,x1):
                        g[y][x]=fill
    return g
